<details>
The PKGBUILD defines sources that are fetched from the official GitHub repository of the project (https://github.com/nao1215/onionscan), specifically downloading release assets including a checksum file and prebuilt binaries for x86_64 and aarch64. The `source` array entries use direct HTTPS URLs to GitHub releases, which is standard practice for binary packages.

The top-level scope of the PKGBUILD contains only variable assignments: no command substitutions, no immediate function calls, and no execution of external code during sourcing. The `pkgver` is hardcoded as 0.2.2 and does not involve any dynamic fetching or parsing from remote sources. Therefore, running `makepkg --nobuild --nodeps --noprepare` will safely download the declared sources without executing any potentially malicious code.

Although the package includes prebuilt binaries (which are not rebuilt from source), this is expected for `-bin` packages in AUR and does not affect the safety of the source-fetching phase. The checksums are provided and will be used by `makepkg` during extraction, but even if they were skipped (which they are not), that would not make this stage unsafe per the gate criteria.
</details>

</summary>
